column1: # Shared Windows/Android/Linux policy vectors. Times and samples are milliseconds.
# reset time preferred; round time wifi wired expected; connected time path failed-preferred expected.
# Sustained improvement waits three minutes, then reverse improvement must wait again.
# A small improvement does not cause a switch.
# Consistently unstable low median loses to a slightly higher but stable median.
# One spike must not become three independent wins in overlapping windows.
# One probe failure is tolerated, repeated failures favor the healthy path.
# An actual foreground failure bypasses the hold; a hedged winner alone does not.
# A candidate with recent failures or invalid timings cannot win.
# Repeated calls in one round cannot manufacture consecutive evidence.
